# 360-skills

> 360-skills is an open, MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills: installable `SKILL.md` packages that give AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 70+ others via skills.sh) senior-level expertise for specific, high-stakes tasks.

Skills follow the open Agent Skills format (https://agentskills.io) and install with a single command via the skills.sh CLI (https://skills.sh). Every skill lives at `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and is self-contained: install it, and the target agent gains that capability on demand through progressive disclosure.

## Skills

- [360-blueprint](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-blueprint/SKILL.md): Universal plan creator for new objectives in any domain. Clarifies the real objective, separates confirmation from generation, avoids invented details, enforces domain quality, and produces a self-contained plan an agent can execute without guessing.
- [360-expert-review](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-expert-review/SKILL.md): Pre-finalization plan review that stress-tests a draft plan for user impact, reliability, security, rollback, traceability, and failure modes. Uses direct expert lenses instead of persona theater and finalizes only after hostile review.
- [360-backend-audit](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-backend-audit/SKILL.md): Deep audit of backend code, APIs, services, business logic, data layers, integrations, and jobs. Verifies correctness, hunts dead weight and duplication, finds safe performance risks, hardens observability, and ends with a usable handover. Functionality, reliability, and accuracy are never traded away.
- [360-token-efficiency](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-token-efficiency/SKILL.md): Runtime skill that reduces token waste during AI-agent tasks without dropping facts, changing requirements, or weakening correctness. Applies silent context discipline, effort sizing, progressive disclosure, compaction, and concise output. Use continuously alongside other skills when token cost matters.
